Context: C. Island Special (Duty) Allowance

| (i) | Areas within the distance of 8 kms. of municipal limits of Capital Towns: (Port Blair in A & N Islands, Kavaratti and Agatti in Lakshadweep.) | 10% of Baise Pay |
| (ii) | Difficult areas: (North and Middle Andaman, South Andaman, excluding Port Blair, all Islands in Lakshadweep except Kavaratti, Agatti and Minicoy.) | 16% of Basic Pay |
